calls.video_title: The UNTHINKABLE is About to Happen to Stocks (Emergency Update)
calls.thesis: Reiterated BUY (last BUY 9 Nov). He is not selling good businesses on red days and is following his schedule: $1,000 a month, triple speed ($1,500) when the S&P 500 is 10% below its 52-week high — which it is, back in correction territory at ~10% below the record. The S&P trades at 17x forward earnings versus 22x at the start of the year and a 19x 10-year average, while Q3 earnings grew 33% and 84% of companies beat expectations.
calls.base: Earnings keep growing and prices follow earnings over time.
calls.bull: The correction proves another 2018/2022/April-2025-style buying opportunity and new highs follow within months.
calls.bear: The sell-off deepens into a proper bear market and the schedule keeps buying into it.

calls.thesis: Sentiment sell-off, not fundamentals: 5% drops happened 25x in 15 years and the S&P is up 500% over that period; hold and dollar-cost average, deploy sidelined cash now while prices are cheap.
calls.price_at_call: S&P 500 -3% in 5 days, -5% in 30 days; profits growing 30%, full-year guide 33%
calls.base_case: This is a sentimental crash (profits still growing), so recovery takes weeks/months (COVID 60 days, 2025 tariffs 12 weeks).
calls.bear_case: A fundamental crash (profits falling, clients lost) would take years (2008 took 5 years) - but he says that is not what is happening.

calls.thesis: Not a price call - portfolio-system guidance: a "big core in the S&P 500" (40-60% of portfolio) is the "undefeated cheat code"; elite stocks must be probable to beat it, max 10 positions, dollar-cost average and double down on the way down.
